Name: Dino Growth
Author: Amichwan
Description:
[b]Dino Growth[/b] completely reworks dinosaurs into true barn animals, with custom growth, new produce, a dedicated dino-only incubator, themed clothing, and powerful boots – all configurable via GMCM.

[b][size=4]Features[/size][/b]

[b]• Dinosaurs are now barn animals[/b]
The vanilla dinosaur is replaced and becomes a [b]barn animal[/b] instead of a coop animal. Baby dinosaurs grow into adults in [b]7 days[/b] by default (configurable).  As adults, they produce every [b]2 days[/b] by default (also configurable).

[b]• [size=4]New produce: Scales and Claws[/size][/b]
Normal produce: [b]Dinosaur Scales[/b] — the standard, reliable product from adult dinosaurs. Deluxe produce: [b]Dinosaur Egg[/b] — obtained as the deluxe product. Super deluxe produce: [b]Dinosaur Claw[/b] — a very rare, high-value drop once friendship is high enough.

[b]• [size=4]Dino Incubator[/size][/b]
[b]Barn-only dino incubator[/b]
Adds a [b]custom incubator[/b] to the [b]Deluxe Barn[/b] that can [b]only[/b] incubate [b]dinosaur eggs[/b]. This incubator [b]does not[/b] work with ostrich eggs. The incubation time is configurable (in in-game minutes), so you can decide how long it should take.

[b]• Compatibility with my mod "More Upgrades"[/b]
If you use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38430]More Upgrades[/url], the same dino-only incubator is automatically added to [b]Super Barn[/b] [b]Premium Barn[/b]

[b]• Compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url][/b] [b]Premium Barn[/b][b]This keeps all upgraded barns consistent and dino-friendly.[/b]

[b]• [size=4]New Clothing & Boots[/size][/b]

[b]Dinosaur Shirt[/b]
Adds a new [b]dinosaur-themed shirt[/b] to complete the vanilla dinosaur outfit. Crafted at the [b]sewing machine[/b] using:
[b]Dinosaur Scales[/b] + [b]Cloth[/b]

[b]Dinosaur Scale Boots[/b]
Green boots made from dinosaur scales. Traded from [b]Marlon[/b] at the Adventurer’s Guild. Cost: [b]20 Dinosaur Scales[/b].
Dinosaur Claw Boots: Yellow boots reinforced with dinosaur claws.  Also traded from [b]Marlon[/b] at the Adventurer’s Guild. Cost: [b]50 Dinosaur Claws[/b].
Both boots have [b]custom Defense and Immunity[/b] values that you can adjust in the config.

[b][size=4]Update 1.0.1[/size][/b]
Added [b]dinosaur sound effects[/b], since dinosaurs did not originally emit any sounds.
Added a [b]craftable Dino Egg Incubator recipe[/b].
Useful if you install the mod in an advanced save and the incubator does not appear automatically.
Especially useful if you use a [b]custom barn map[/b].
Also allows you to build [b]additional incubators[/b] if desired.
This incubator only works [b]inside a Barn[/b] and can be [b]enabled or disabled[/b] via config.

Added an option to choose whether dinosaurs are [b]barn animals or coop animals[/b].
If you choose the [b]coop dinosaur[/b], it will [b]not grow[/b].
Due to game logic, a growing dinosaur cannot leave the coop when the door is opened.
In this mode, the dinosaur keeps its [b]vanilla appearance[/b] but still produces the items from this mod.

[b][size=4]Configuration (GMCM support)[/size][/b]

This mod supports [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] (GMCM) for in-game configuration.
You can toggle and tweak things like:
Enable/disable the [b]barn dino incubator[/b].
Enable/disable the [b]dinosaur shirt.
Enable/disable the [b]dinosaur boots.
Days to mature[/b] for dinosaurs.
Production interval[/b] (how often they produce).
Incubation time[/b] for the dino incubator (in in-game minutes).
Defense and Immunity values for both pairs of boots.

[b][size=4]Translations[/size][/b]
Includes an [b]i18n[/b] file.
Currently provides [b]Spanish[/b] (es), [b]German[/b] (de) and [b]Japanese [/b](ja) translations.
